svg.text: Set up your first keyboard. You can add more keyboards and layouts at any time.
Choose your keyboard and PCB revision
from the catalog, then a template.
Bring an existing Zig keymap from a
repository or folder and compare first.
Open a project or a whole collection
New layouts are saved in the collection
Nothing is written until you create a layout. No keyboard is accessed or flashed from this screen.
